lead.label: 1 (HLM006474)
lead.why: Title and abstract: 'An improved green synthesis of the E2F inhibitor HLM0066474 is described'; the only compound made. The (+)-R enantiomer is the active one, but the enantiomers are obtained by preparative chiral HPLC of the racemate, which is a separation, not a reaction.

reactions.conditions: K2CO3, DMF, rt 25 min then 80 °C, 3 h; 77%, used without further purification
Three-component Betti reaction, solvent-free, 55 °C, 24 h (thermal), 66%; or microwave 60 °C 24 h (71%) or 95 °C 6.5 h with 1.2 eq. aminopyridine (67-70%). Triturated in EtOH.
reactions.source: SI, 'Thermal preparation of ... (HLM006474) 1' and 'Microwave assisted preparation'; main text Tables 1-2

notes: Target is the racemate (one stereocentre, drawn without stereo). The (R) and (S) enantiomers come from semi-preparative chiral HPLC (Chiralpak ID) of the racemate, so there is no stereo-selective reaction. Reagents 'purchased from Aldrich or Fluka'. Printed name of 1 is the SI/introduction form; the HRMS line in the SI reads 'M - H' for a [M+H] value (paper's inconsistency, irrelevant to the structure). The paper's introduction also describes the earlier literature route (same two steps).
